9.name: 901 (Auditions)
9.overview: Luke, Lionel, Carrie and Ryan welcome the newest class of hopefuls to Idol University in Nashville, where future stars take their first steps toward becoming the next "American Idol."

9.name: 902 (Auditions)
9.overview: Auditions continue, with hopefuls stepping into the spotlight and delivering unforgettable performances.

9.name: 903 (Auditions)
9.overview: The stakes continue to rise as additional hopefuls face the judges with electrifying performances, each vying for a chance at the coveted golden ticket.

9.name: 904 (Auditions)
9.overview: In the final week of auditions, rising stars deliver showstopping performances that stun Luke, Lionel, Carrie and Ryan, setting the stage for Hollywood Week.

9.name: 905 (Hollywood Week in Music City (1))
9.overview: For the first time, Idol is bringing Hollywood Week to Music City as hopefuls take the stage for a make-or-break performance and face the biggest Hollywood Week cut in Idol history.

9.name: 906 (Hollywood Week in Music City (2))
9.overview: Hollywood Week in Music City continues, pushing hopefuls to their maximum potential as they compete to wow the judges; in the end, only 30 move forward.

9.name: 907 ('Ohana Round)
9.overview: At Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa in Ko Olina, Hawai'i, hopefuls take the stage to perform for their own families, industry tastemakers and their fellow hopefuls; 20 contestants move forward.

9.name: 908 (Top 20 at Disney's Aulani Resort in Hawai'i (1))
9.overview: As the competition continues at Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa in Ko Olina, Hawaiʻi, Brad Paisley and Keke Palmer mentor the Top 20 hopefuls. Keke also serves as a guest judge, while Iam Tongi and Thunderstorm Artis perform.

9.name: 909 (Top 20 at Disney's Aulani Resort in Hawai'i (2))
9.overview: In the final week at Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa in Ko Olina, Hawai'i, Brad Paisley and Keke Palmer continue mentoring the top 20 hopefuls, Keke returns to the judging panel and takes the stage for a performance, Skip Marley performs.

9.name: Songs of Faith
9.overview: The hopefuls lift their voices in inspiring songs of faith, 12 finalists continue on the journey to become the next singing sensation.

9.name: 911 (90s Judges' Song Contest)
9.overview: The Top 12 perform '90s hits secretly picked by Luke Bryan, Lionel Richie or Carrie Underwood; stars of ABC's "TGIF" '90s lineup hang with the hopefuls in the lounge as America votes for the Top 11.

9.name: 912 (Rock & Roll Hall of Fame)
9.overview: The Top 11 perform iconic hits from Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductees; inductees for the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame class of 2026 ceremony are revealed.

9.name: 913 (Disney Night)
9.overview: The Top 9 bring iconic Disney songs to life as America votes live to decide which seven finalists move one step closer to their dream of becoming the next "American Idol."

9.name: 914 (Celebrating Taylor Swift on American Idol)
9.overview: The Top 7 celebrate Taylor Swift's chart-topping hits and defining eras as America votes live to reveal the Top 5; a salute to California's biggest artists; Nikki Glaser guest judges.

9.name: 915 (Class of 2006: Reunion/Idol X DWTS)
9.overview: At the "American Idol" 20th high school reunion, fan-favorite idols from the class of 2006, along with special guests, return as "Dancing With the Stars" pros bring some ballroom flair to the celebration; America votes live for the Top 3.

9.name: 916 (Grand Finale)
9.overview: The Top 3 finalists give their all for the last chance to earn America's vote; Alicia Keys performs and serves as guest mentor; special performances from other music legends and today's top stars.

lastEpisodeToAir.overview: The Top 3 finalists give their all for the last chance to earn America's vote; Alicia Keys performs and serves as guest mentor; special performances from other music legends and today's top stars.

overview: The iconic series that revolutionized the television landscape by pioneering the music competition genre is back!
tagline: Heading back to where it all began.
title: American Idol
